description: Our light was a little dimmer last month. John Lewis, Rev. C.T. Vivian, Charles Evers, and Emma Sanders left the earth. They left behind a legacy of dismantling white supremacy and oppression, organizing voters, pioneering boycotts, and challenging segregation and discrimination in our legislative bodies and delegations. They were trailblazers. They were legends. I reflect […]

title: Carrying the Torch to Justice: A Tribute to Freedom Fighters - Natalie Murdock for NC Senate
